summary.plain: The Korean-led group (Korea Invisible Mass Search) that searched for dark matter with crystal detectors at the Yangyang underground laboratory. Its CsI(Tl) and NaI(Tl) work led into the COSINE-100 experiment.
summary.technical: Korea Invisible Mass Search (KIMS) Collaboration: CsI(Tl) WIMP search (KIMS-CsI, 2004-2012) and NaI(Tl) development and limits (KIMS-NaI, 2013-2015) at Y2L, run from Seoul National University and then the IBS Center for Underground Physics; Tsinghua University (China) is among the authors of the 2012 CsI(Tl) paper. KIMS and DM-Ice then joined to build COSINE-100.
